chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight
spiritual_reading:
The first degree in which this holy love is present is the outermost recipient state where it can appear and act. There it is fixed beneath what transcends all comprehension, and from that lowest plane it serves as the base and support of an entire ordered system, holding together the most general discernment that lies under all particular things.

The second degree in which it is present is in the Divine source of truth itself, because the Divine is set in an infinite and mighty wisdom. Therefore love is first in the Divine, and from that same Divine all subordinate powers proceeded; and with their proceeding, love went forth as their inner life and was made manifest through their operation.

The third degree in which it is present is in the primal heavenly human, the first formed reception of the Divine in a distinct form for combat and protection. Here love is the very strength that invests perfected humanity, giving it power in its embodied fullness.

The fourth degree is love as it has been purified from every inferior admixture within the whole complex of enlightened powers, and set in the ultimate boundary of outward manifestation, in the orderly progression by which higher things are carried into external use.

The fifth degree is love as it is present in a lesser illumination that governs states of obscurity, held within truths as they exist in a more external and reflective level of understanding.

The sixth degree is love purified from the whole of what is lower, which the living Divine operation bound to itself as a covering and instrument for action, in order to effect both the calling forth of lower states and their responsive submission to higher rule. By this love many determinate forms were established; yet when descent to the lowest threshold was required, that operation laid aside this glory before entrance into the most external guardianship.

The seventh degree is living love belonging to a renewed spiritual order, and it is the governing wisdom within that order. It is the first basis of the renewed state; from it the entire arrangement was rebuilt anew, beginning with the first encompassing formation that unites and completes all things in that order. This stands beneath what is beyond all, extending over the whole domain of falsity and evil in its ultimate spread, restraining it and enclosing it within fixed limits, though the remaining details here resist full clarity.

The eighth degree is love that will be made manifest within a final representative reception, and it has the character of dread and spiritual conflict. It makes itself known by the sign of its formidable presence, bringing exposure and revelation through the awe it induces. It will be disclosed through a full conjunction of higher and lower manifestations of enlightened truth.

Such is the manner in which the holy living love has its existence through these eight degrees.

fills.notes: The first ‘place’ is the outermost receptacle-state (‘light land’) standing as a base beneath what transcends the whole. The clause must assert stable being there: ‘is established beneath it, and is utterly beyond the totality’ preserves the discrete-degree contrast (beneath vs beyond) required by the spiritual translation.
Completes ‘consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all’ as the abstract governing discernment underlying particulars (impersonal substrate register).

The third degree is the First Man as primal combat-form. The text wants the idiom of investiture for battle: he ‘is clothed in armour’. This matches the correspondential idea that love is strength as a protective covering.
Parallels ¶7 where the Living Spirit ‘swathed’ the fire on his body. In the third place, the fire functions as the binding, strengthening investiture upon the Perfect Man’s body.

The fifth degree is the night luminary: a lesser illumination governing obscurity. Correspondentially it is love present in reflective truths (‘within the water’), so a verb of containment fits: it is ‘held within the water’.

After ‘they built anew’ the renewed order must be described as an ordered rebuilding beginning from the first encompassing formation. The phrase supplies the required governing-structure sense without importing later devotional diction.

Seventh degree stands over the whole earth of darkness to limit and enclose it. The verb must express boundary-setting and restraint, matching the spiritual translation’s ‘restraining it and enclosing it within fixed limits’.
Needs a noun for the limiting structure within which darkness is contained; ‘boundary’ matches the wall-crown imagery (first course as crown) and the function of fixed limits.
Minimal connective demanded by the remaining clause ‘in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]’; preserves a genitival construction without over-specifying what the damaged exemplar no longer supports.

The eighth degree is to appear ‘in this … person’: correspondentially a final representative reception. ‘Last formed’ keeps the impersonal cosmological register (formation, not biography) and fits the eschatological disclosure described.
The eighth is characterized by dread and conflict; the syntax ‘Furthermore it … it displays’ needs an appositive predicate introducing that quality before describing its sign-manifestation.

assessment: Most gaps are small and restore directly. The larger losses are in ¶4 and especially ¶8–¶9; there the correspondential structure tightly constrains function (investiture for combat; boundary-setting over darkness; final representative manifestation with dread and war), but exact phrasing remains only moderately recoverable. Where the exemplar is too indeterminate (¶8 #6), the restoration is kept minimal to avoid importing later overlay language.
